```{r, include = FALSE}
library(gt)
library(glue)
source("scripts/fertility_data.R")
```


## Statistical Methods

All analyses were performed in R (v4.5.2). Fecundity (egg counts) was modelled using a zero-inflated negative binomial (nbinom1) mixed model fitted with glmmTMB, with genetic line, cross and their interaction as fixed effects, an intercept-only zero-inflation component, and replicate and plate well as nested random effects. Hatching rate was modelled using a binomial generalised linear mixed model (GLMM), also fitted with glmmTMB. Estimated marginal means and contrasts were obtained using emmeans; each genotype is compared with the wildtype (WT) group of the same line (treatment-versus-control, Dunnett-adjusted within line). Post-blood-feeding survival, trans-heterozygote survival, and XA supplementation survival data were modelled using Weibull parametric survival models fitted with flexsurv. Groups in which no female died have no estimable time ratio (complete separation) and, if included, corrupt flexsurv's standard errors for every other group; these groups were fitted out of the Weibull models, shown by Kaplan–Meier curves only, and compared using log-rank tests. Time ratios against each line's WT siblings were computed from the model coefficients and covariance matrix (Holm-adjusted within line). XA supplementation was analysed separately for each supplementation route (each treatment within a route was a single cage), using heterozygotes only, with the pooled model and an arm × treatment test as supporting evidence. Midgut integrity (smurf assay) and adult eclosion data were modelled using binomial generalised linear models (GLMs) fitted with base R glm(). Gene expression data were analysed using the delta-delta-Ct method; ΔCt levels were modelled with a permutation-based linear model using emmeans for contrasts. Model tables were produced using sjPlot. Survival curves were visualised using Kaplan–Meier estimates alongside Weibull model predictions. All figures were produced using ggplot2 and patchwork.

## Fecundity (STable 3; Fig. 1A)

**STable 3a.** Fecundity: model coefficients (zero-inflated negative binomial GLMM).

```{r}

line_labels_html <- c(
  "(Intercept)"                    = "Intercept (QA383P, SDA&times;SDA)",
  "line2360B5"                     = "<em>cd</em><sup>g225</sup>",
  "line1759"                       = "<em>cd</em><sup>g384</sup>",
  "crossFemale \nHET"              = "Female Het",
  "crossMale \nHET"                = "Male Het",
  "crossFemale \nHOM"              = "Female Hom",
  "crossMale \nHOM"                = "Male Hom",
  "line2360B5:crossFemale \nHET"   = "<em>cd</em><sup>g225</sup> &times; Female Het",
  "line1759:crossFemale \nHET"     = "<em>cd</em><sup>g384</sup> &times; Female Het",
  "line2360B5:crossMale \nHET"     = "<em>cd</em><sup>g225</sup> &times; Male Het",
  "line1759:crossMale \nHET"       = "<em>cd</em><sup>g384</sup> &times; Male Het",
  "line1759:crossFemale \nHOM"     = "<em>cd</em><sup>g384</sup> &times; Female Hom",
  "line1759:crossMale \nHOM"       = "<em>cd</em><sup>g384</sup> &times; Male Hom"
)

tab_model(egg_model, pred.labels = line_labels_html)
```

**STable 3b.** Estimated eggs per female: conditional (non-zero) mean, and expected count including zeros.

```{r}
cond_emm <- emmeans(egg_model, ~ line * cross, component = "cond", type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(count = response)

# ZI component is intercept-only — extract single p(zero) estimate
zi_coef <- fixef(egg_model)$zi[["(Intercept)"]]
p_zero  <- plogis(zi_coef)  # convert log-odds to probability

cond_emm |>
  mutate(expected_count = count * (1 - p_zero),
      line = recode(line,
      "QA383P" = "<em>cd</em><sup>384R</sup>",
      "1759"   = "<em>cd</em><sup>g384</sup>",
      "2360B5" = "<em>cd</em><sup>g225</sup>"
    )) |>
  select(line, cross, count, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL, expected_count) |>

  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1))) |>
  gt() |>
   fmt_markdown(columns = line) |> 
  cols_label(
    line           = "Line",
    cross          = "Cross",
    count          = "Conditional mean",
    asymp.LCL       = "Lower 95% CI",
    asymp.UCL       = "Upper 95% CI",
    expected_count = "Expected count (incl. zeros)"
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Non-zero wells",
    columns = c(count, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL)
  ) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = glue::glue("Structural zero probability = {round(p_zero, 3)}; expected count = conditional mean \u00d7 (1 \u2212 p_zero)"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = expected_count)
  ) |>
  fmt_number(decimals = 1) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_spanners()
  ) |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)
```


**STable 3c.** Line comparisons within each cross. This is the source of the female-heterozygote contrast in comments 9 and 10 (z = 0.57, p = 0.57).

```{r}
line_html <- c(
  "1759"    = "<em>cd</em><sup>g384</sup>",
  "2360B5"  = "<em>cd</em><sup>g225</sup>",
  "2072"    = "<em>cd</em><sup>g384del</sup>",
  "2301"    = "<em>cd</em><sup>g338-384</sup>",
  "D251"    = "<em>cd</em><sup>225R</sup>",
  "QA383P"  = "<em>cd</em><sup>384R</sup>"
)

cons <- get_emm_contrasts(egg_model)

cons$line_by_cross |>
  mutate(contrast = str_replace_all(contrast, line_html)) |>
  select(contrast, cross, ratio, ratio.LCL, ratio.UCL, z.ratio, p.value) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = contrast) |>
  cols_label(
    contrast  = "Contrast",
    cross     = "Cross",
    ratio     = "IRR",
    ratio.LCL = "Lower 95% CI",
    ratio.UCL = "Upper 95% CI",
    z.ratio   = "z",
    p.value   = "p"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(ratio, ratio.LCL, ratio.UCL, z.ratio), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt(columns = p.value, fns = \(x) ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f"))) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Line comparisons within cross", columns = everything()) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_spanners()
  ) |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)
```

**STable 3e (new; comment 5).** Each cross versus the WT group of the same line (Dunnett).

```{r}
# Each cross versus its own line's WT group
vs_wt_table <- function(x, ratio_label, title) {
  x |>
    mutate(
      contrast = str_replace_all(contrast, "\n", ""),
      line = recode(as.character(line), !!!line_html)
    ) |>
    select(line, contrast, ratio, ratio.LCL, ratio.UCL, z.ratio, p.value) |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = line) |>
    cols_label(
      line = "Line",
      contrast = "Contrast",
      ratio = ratio_label,
      ratio.LCL = "Lower 95% CI",
      ratio.UCL = "Upper 95% CI",
      z.ratio = "z",
      p.value = "p (Dunnett)"
    ) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(ratio, ratio.LCL, ratio.UCL, z.ratio), decimals = 2) |>
    fmt(columns = p.value, fns = \(x) ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f"))) |>
    tab_spanner(label = title, columns = everything()) |>
    opt_stylize(style = 1)
}

vs_wt_table(egg_vs_wt, "IRR", "Each cross versus WT of the same line")
```

**STable 3f (new; comment 6).** Observed egg counts and proportion of females laying any eggs.

```{r}
# Observed egg counts (all females with a count, including zeros)
fertility_data |>
  filter(!is.na(eggs)) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_eggs = mean(eggs),
    median_eggs = median(eggs),
    prop_laying = mean(eggs > 0),
    .by = c(line, cross)
  ) |>
  arrange(line, cross) |>
  mutate(
    cross = str_replace_all(cross, "\n", ""),
    line = recode(as.character(line), !!!line_html)
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = line) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean_eggs, median_eggs), decimals = 1) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = prop_laying, decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(
    line = "Line",
    cross = "Cross",
    n = "Females",
    mean_eggs = "Mean eggs",
    median_eggs = "Median eggs",
    prop_laying = "Laid any eggs"
  ) |>
  tab_footnote("The zero-inflation component is intercept-only, so the model assumes the same proportion of non-laying females in every group; observed proportions range widely.") |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)
```

**STable 5b (new; comment 5).** Each heterozygous or homozygous group versus the WT siblings of the same line.

```{r}
# Time-ratio table helper (shared with the trans-het section)
tr_table <- function(x, title) {
  x |>
    mutate(
      observed = glue::glue("{deaths}/{n} vs {deaths_ref}/{n_ref}"),
      across(c(tr, tr_lcl, tr_ucl), \(v) signif(v, 3))
    ) |>
    select(level, ref, observed, tr, tr_lcl, tr_ucl, p_raw, p_adj) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      level = "Group",
      ref = "Compared with",
      observed = "Deaths/n (group vs comparator)",
      tr = "Time ratio",
      tr_lcl = "Lower 95% CI",
      tr_ucl = "Upper 95% CI",
      p_raw = "p",
      p_adj = "p (Holm)"
    ) |>
    fmt(columns = c(p_raw, p_adj), fns = \(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f")))) |>
    sub_missing(missing_text = "not estimable") |>
    tab_spanner(label = title, columns = everything()) |>
    opt_stylize(style = 1)
}

tr_table(bf_vs_wt, "Each Het/Hom group versus WT siblings of the same line")
```

## Trans-heterozygote survival (STable 8; Fig. 5)

**STable 8a.** Weibull model with time ratios relative to *cd*^g225^ heterozygotes, with corrected standard errors (Section B1).

```{r}
transhet_labels_html <- c(
  "(Intercept)" = "Intercept (2360B5 Het)",
  "line_treatment2360WT" = "2360B5 WT",
  "line_treatmentD251:2360Het" = "Trans-het (D251:2360 Het)",
  "line_treatmentD251:2360WT" = "Het<sup>KO</sup> (D251:2360 WT)"
)

tab_model(
  weibull_th$model,
  pred.labels = transhet_labels_html,
  show.re.var = FALSE,
  digits = 3
)
```

Group key: 2360Het = *cd*^g225^ het; 2360WT = its WT siblings; D251:2360Het = *cd*^g225^;*cd*^225R^ trans-het; D251:2360WT = *cd*^225R^ het (no deaths, fitted out of the model).

**STable 8c.** Survival probability at 100 h (values quoted in the text).

```{r}
# Survival probability at a fixed time point, per group
summary(weibull_th$model, type = "survival", t = 100, ci = TRUE) |>
  map_dfr(as_tibble, .id = "group") |>
  mutate(
    line     = str_extract(group, "(?<=line_treatment=).+"),
    genotype = str_extract(line, "Het|WT|Hom"),
    line     = str_remove(line, "Het|WT|Hom") |> str_trim(),
    line = recode(line,
      "2360" = "<em>cd</em><sup>g225</sup>",
      "D251" = "<em>cd</em><sup>225R</sup>",
      "D251:2360" = "<em>cd</em><sup>g225</sup>:<em>cd</em><sup>225R</sup>"
    ))  |>
  select(line, genotype, est, lcl, ucl) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_markdown() |> 
  cols_label(
    line     = "Line",
    genotype = "Genotype",
    est      = "Survival",
    lcl      = "Lower 95% CI",
    ucl      = "Upper 95% CI"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(est, lcl, ucl), decimals = 3) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Survival probability at 100 h",
    columns = c(est, lcl, ucl)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_spanners()
  ) |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)

```

### Per-route analysis of heterozygotes (reviewer comment 4)

Each treatment within a supplementation route was a single cage, so a replicate term cannot be estimated. Each route is therefore analysed separately (heterozygotes only: 1 of 112 WT females died).

```{r}
  gt(groupname_col = "experiment") |>
  cols_label(genotype = "Genotype", dosage_mM = "Treatment", n = "Females", deaths = "Died") |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)
```

**STable 7b.** Per-route Weibull models of heterozygotes: treatment contrasts.

```{r}
xa_arm_contrasts |>
  select(experiment, contrast, tr, tr_lcl, tr_ucl, p_raw, p_adj) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "experiment") |>
  cols_label(
    contrast = "Contrast",
    tr = "Time ratio",
    tr_lcl = "Lower 95% CI",
    tr_ucl = "Upper 95% CI",
    p_raw = "p",
    p_adj = "p (Holm, 3 contrasts)"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(tr, tr_lcl, tr_ucl), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt(columns = c(p_raw, p_adj), fns = \(x) ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f"))) |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)
```

**STable 7c.** Overall treatment effect within each route (likelihood-ratio test, 2 df). With three groups, unadjusted pairwise contrasts following a significant omnibus test (Fisher's protected LSD) control the family-wise error rate.


## Larva-to-adult survival (STable 1)

```{r, include = FALSE}
source("scripts/hom_survival.R")
```

Larva-to-adult survival was assessed in trays of 200 mixed-sex larvae (two trays per genotype and line), with adults scored by sex. The number of adults of each sex out of 200 larvae was modelled with a binomial GLM including line (1759 vs QA383P), genotype (WT, HET, HOM), sex and all interactions (n = 24 observations). Because each sex-specific count is out of 200 mixed-sex larvae, ~50% is the maximum under a 1:1 sex ratio. WT = non-transgenic siblings for *cd*^g384^ and SDA-500 for *cd*^384R^. The reference cell was QA383P, HET, female.

*cd*^g384^ homozygotes almost entirely failed to reach adulthood as females (3/400 larvae; 0.75%) and were strongly reduced as males (54/400; 13.5%), whereas *cd*^384R^ homozygotes did not differ from WT in either sex (contrasts below).

**STable 1a (new; comments 6 and 11).** Observed larvae, pupae and adults by line, genotype and sex.

```{r}
eclosion_observed |>
  gt(groupname_col = "line") |>
  fmt_percent(columns = prop_adults, decimals = 1) |>
  cols_label(trays = "Trays", larvae = "Larvae", pupae = "Pupae", adults = "Adults", prop_adults = "Adults / larvae") |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)
```

**STable 1b (new; comment 5).** Each genotype versus WT within line and sex (Dunnett).

```{r}
eclosion_vs_wt |>
  select(line, Sex, contrast, ratio, ratio.LCL, ratio.UCL, z.ratio, p.value) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(ratio, ratio.LCL, ratio.UCL, z.ratio), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt(columns = p.value, fns = \(x) ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f"))) |>
  cols_label(ratio = "OR", ratio.LCL = "Lower 95% CI", ratio.UCL = "Upper 95% CI", z.ratio = "z", p.value = "p (Dunnett)") |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Each genotype versus WT within line and sex", columns = everything()) |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)
```

**STable 1c.** Binomial GLM coefficients.

#### Contrasts

```{r}
larvae_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model, specs = ~ line + Genotype + Sex, type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() 
```

**STable 1d.** Genotype comparisons within line and sex (Tukey). This is the source of the *cd*^384R^ ORs in the current text (HET/HOM 0.82, WT/HOM 0.78).

```{r}
emm1 <- emmeans::emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Genotype | line + Sex)
  contrasts1 <- as_tibble(emm1$contrasts) |>
    drop_na() |>
    mutate(
      ratio = exp(estimate),
      ratio.LCL = exp(estimate - 1.96 * SE),
      ratio.UCL = exp(estimate + 1.96 * SE)
    )

gt(contrasts1)
```

**STable 1e.** Line comparisons within genotype and sex. This is the source of OR = 1.22, p = 0.157 (shown here as its inverse, *cd*^384R^/*cd*^g384^ = 0.82).

```{r}
emm2 <- emmeans::emmeans(model, pairwise ~ line | Genotype + Sex)
  contrasts2 <- as_tibble(emm2$contrasts) |>
    drop_na() |>
    mutate(
      ratio = exp(estimate),
      ratio.LCL = exp(estimate - 1.96 * SE),
      ratio.UCL = exp(estimate + 1.96 * SE)
    )
    
gt(contrasts2)
```


## qPCR (Fig. 6; SFig. 5)

Each line is compared with SDA-500 within sex using a linear model of ΔCt. Significance comes from a Freedman–Lane permutation test (5,000 permutations of reduced-model residuals within sex). This was corrected on 2026-11-06: the earlier version sign-flipped full-model residuals, which gave invalid p-values.

```{r, include = FALSE}
results <- readRDS("data/ddCt_results.rds")
```

**Statistics for Fig. 6 and SFig. 5 (suggested new STable).** Each line versus SDA-500 within sex.

```{r}
imap(results, \(r, nm) r$contrasts$permuted |> mutate(normalisation = nm)) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  select(normalisation, Sex, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value, p.perm) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "normalisation") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(estimate, SE, t.ratio), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt(columns = c(p.value, p.perm), fns = \(x) ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f"))) |>
  cols_label(estimate = "Difference in ΔCt", t.ratio = "t", p.value = "p (parametric)", p.perm = "p (permutation)") |>
  opt_stylize(style = 1)
```

